`create_model` computes `flat` but never converts `sns` itself: the variable and constraint builders still receive the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`, including the transmission-loss builders. Although `_snapshots_parameter` flattens the model parameter and the context flattens component data, neither changes the `sns` arguments, so `"flat"` (and `"auto"` under v1 semantics) does not satisfy the criterion.
